text_en: You will be in the right, O Lord , when I lay charges against you; but let me put my case to you. Why does the way of the guilty prosper? Why do all who are treacherous thrive?
text_cn: 上主，几时我与你争辩，总是你有理；但我仍愿与你讨论正义：“为什么恶人的生活总是顺利，一般诡诈极恶的人总享安宁？

text_en: You plant them, and they take root; they grow and bring forth fruit; you are near in their mouths yet far from their hearts.
text_cn: 你栽植了他们，他们就生根滋长，结出果实；他们的口离你近，他们的心却离你远。

text_en: But you, O Lord , know me; You see me and test me—my heart is with you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and set them apart for the day of slaughter.
text_cn: 至于你，上主，你是认识我和了解我的，你考察了我对你的心意；求你把他们像待宰的羊一样拉出来，留待宰杀的一天。

text_en: How long will the land mourn, and the grass of every field wither? For the wickedness of those who live in it the animals and the birds are swept away, and because people said, “He is blind to our ways. ”
text_cn: 【这地要哀伤，整个田野的草木要枯萎到几时？由于居民的邪恶，野兽和飞鸟都被消灭。】因为他们说：“天主不管我们的作为。”

text_en: If you have raced with foot-runners and they have wearied you, how will you compete with horses? And if in a safe land you fall down, how will you fare in the thickets of the Jordan?
text_cn: “你与人徒步竞走，尚觉疲乏，你怎么能与马角逐？在平安的地区尚觉不安全，在约但河的丛林区，你更将何如？

text_en: For even your kinsfolk and your own family, even they have dealt treacherously with you; they are in full cry after you; do not believe them, though they speak friendly words to you.
text_cn: 连你的兄弟和你的父族，对你都无诚意，在你后面厉声喊叫；即使他们对你说好话，你也不要相信。”

text_en: I have forsaken my house, I have abandoned my heritage; I have given the beloved of my heart into the hands of her enemies.
text_cn: “我离开了我的家，抛弃了我的产业，将我最心爱的交在敌人的手中。

text_en: My heritage has become to me like a lion in the forest; she has lifted up her voice against me— therefore I hate her.
text_cn: 我的产业对我竟好像是森林中的狮子，向我咆哮，为此我憎恨它。

text_en: Is the hyena greedy for my heritage at my command? Are the birds of prey all around her? Go, assemble all the wild animals; bring them to devour her.
text_cn: 我的产业对我竟成了一只带斑点的鸷（zhì）鸟，以致鸷鸟围着向它袭击。你们去聚集田野的一切野兽，叫它们来吞噬。

text_en: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard, they have trampled down my portion, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
text_cn: 许多牧童毁坏了我的葡萄园，蹂躏了我的产业，使我喜爱的产业变为荒芜的旷野。

text_en: They have made it a desolation; desolate, it mourns to me. The whole land is made desolate, but no one lays it to heart.
text_cn: 他们使它荒凉，荒凉得在我面前哀伤；全地荒凉，因为没有一人关心。

text_en: Upon all the bare heights in the desert spoilers have come; for the sword of the Lord devours from one end of the land to the other; no one shall be safe.
text_cn: 破坏者已来到旷野的一切高岗上，因为上主的刀剑正在砍伐，从地极到地极，凡有血肉的，都不得安宁。

text_en: They have sown wheat and have reaped thorns, they have tired themselves out but profit nothing. They shall be ashamed of their harvests because of the fierce anger of the Lord .
text_cn: 他们播种了麦子，却收割了荆棘；虽筋疲力竭，却没有利益；由于上主的盛怒，都因自己的收获而害羞。

text_en: Thus says the Lord concerning all my evil neighbors who touch the heritage that I have given my people Israel to inherit: I am about to pluck them up from their land, and I will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.
text_cn: 上主这样说：关于那些险恶的邻邦，即侵犯我给予我民以色列占有的产业的邻邦，看，我要由他们的地上将他们拔除，也要由他们中拔除犹大家。

text_en: And after I have plucked them up, I will again have compassion on them, and I will bring them again to their heritage and to their land, every one of them.
text_cn: 在我拔除他们以后，我要再怜悯他们，引他们复归自己的产业，各回自己的故乡。

text_en: And then, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, “As the Lord lives, ” as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they shall be built up in the midst of my people.
text_cn: 设若他们殷勤学走我人民的道路，奉我名发誓说“上主永在”，如同他们昔日教我人民奉巴耳发誓一样，他们就可在我的人民中再度复兴。

text_en: But if any nation will not listen, then I will completely uproot it and destroy it, says the Lord .
text_cn: 倘若他们不听从，我必拔除这民族，将她拔除消灭──上主的断语。
